scanNote:
12-UNITNING TO'RTINChI BETI (85-bet) - MUZ MEHMONXONASI va WHO/WHERE/WHICH.

Yuqorida o'ngda KO'K-YaShIL yorliqda oq '12', chapida 'Holidays with a Difference'.

CHAP USTUN:
• To'q sariq 'Reading & Listening'.
11) Kasseta belgisi: 'Look at the picture and try to answer the questions, then listen and check your answers.' 1 What can you see in the picture? a a hotel in the desert b a hotel made of ice. 2 What can you find in the hotel? a a sauna b a chapel c a theatre d a bar e a cinema f a swimming pool. 3 What can you do inside the hotel? a have a meal b meet a model c watch TV d sleep in a sleeping bag e play ice hockey f dance all night. 4 What outdoor activities are there? a dog-sledding b skiing c yachting d rafting e ice-fishing.
   SURAT: qordan/muzdan qurilgan oq bino, oldida qora kiyimli odam ketmoqda.
   OCh KO'K QUTI, ko'k sarlavha '3 Degrees Below Freezing':
   1: 'Looking for an exciting winter GETAWAY? Then try the Ice Hotel in northern Sweden and spend a few days in a giant IGLOO. 2,000 TONNES of ice and 30,000 tonnes of snow are needed to build the Ice Hotel every year. When the THERMOMETER hits 3 DEGREES BELOW FREEZING, the building of the hotel starts.'
   2: 'The hotel has rooms for over 100 guests, as well as an ice sauna, a cinema, the Ice Chapel and the world-famous Absolut Ice Bar. The temperature inside the hotel is minus 3 degrees Celsius, but that seems warm when you compare it to the temperature outside, which can fall below minus 30 degrees Celsius.'
   3: 'Before bedtime, have a meal PREPARED by MASTER CHEFS, then visit the Absolut Ice Bar, where you might just meet your favourite model or actor, or enjoy a CRYSTAL-CLEAR VIEW of the STARRY Arctic sky. When it's time for bed, don't worry about keeping warm. The Ice Hotel provides guests with warm SLEEPING BAGS to sleep in. Guests wake up to a hot drink, after which they can enjoy an early morning sauna and a tasty breakfast.'
   4: 'The Arctic is the perfect place for OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES such as DOG-SLEDDING, ice-fishing and skiing. If you haven't got skis, the STAFF at RECEPTION will provide you with everything you need.'
   5: 'A visit to the Ice Hotel is an UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCE and the perfect way to LIVEN UP your winter. Don't miss this chance of a lifetime!'

O'NG USTUN:
12) 'Read the article and match the headings to the paragraphs, then explain the words in bold.' A Description; B Recommendation; C Name/Location/Why special; D Indoor activities; E Outdoor activities.
• To'q sariq 'Speaking': 'Take notes under the headings in Ex. 12, then talk about the Ice Hotel.'
• To'q sariq 'Grammar: Who - Where - Which'.
13) 'Study the examples, then say when we use who, where and which.' TO'Q SARIQ RAMKA: • 'I spoke to a policeman. He was very helpful.' → 'I spoke to a policeman WHO was very helpful.' • 'I went to Spain. I met my husband there.' → 'I went to Spain WHERE I met my husband.' • 'A CD player is a machine. It plays music.' → 'A CD player is a machine WHICH plays music.'
14) 'Match the jobs to the job descriptions, then make sentences with who, as in the example.' 1 barman (ko'k strelka → c) 2 porter 3 chef 4 maid 5 waiter 6 receptionist | a cook food b serve meals c serve drinks d welcome guests e carry luggage f clean rooms. Ko'k qiya: 'A barman is someone WHO serves drinks.'
15) Kasseta belgisi: qiya 'Barry and Sandra went to London last summer.' 'Listen and match the places they visited to what they did in each place. Finally, make sentences with where, as in the example.' 1 The Barbican Theatre 2 Trafalgar Square 3 The National Gallery 4 The Savoy Hotel 5 Highbury Stadium | a see Nelson's Column b see Romeo and Juliet c watch a football match d admire the paintings e have afternoon tea. Ko'k qiya: 'They went to the Barbican Theatre, WHERE they saw Romeo and Juliet.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '85'.

exercises.explanationUz:
MATN TARJIMASI:

1) Hayajonli qishki sayohat
qidiryapsizmi? Unda Shvetsiya
shimolidagi Muz mehmonxonasini
sinab ko'ring va ulkan igluda bir
necha kun o'tkazing. Har yili Muz
mehmonxonasini qurish uchun 2000
tonna muz va 30000 tonna qor kerak.
Termometr muzlashdan 3 daraja
pastga tushganda mehmonxona
qurilishi boshlanadi.

2) Mehmonxonada 100 dan ortiq
mehmon uchun xonalar, shuningdek
muz saunasi, kinoteatr, Muz
ibodatxonasi va dunyoga mashhur
Absolut Muz bari bor. Mehmonxona
ichidagi harorat minus 3 daraja
Selsiy, lekin tashqaridagi harorat
bilan solishtirganda bu iliq
tuyuladi - tashqarida minus 30
darajadan pastga tushishi mumkin.

3) Uyqudan oldin usta oshpazlar
tayyorlagan ovqatni yeng, keyin
Absolut Muz bariga boring - u yerda
sevimli model yoki aktyoringizni
uchratishingiz yoki yulduzli Arktika
osmonining kristaldek tiniq
manzarasidan bahramand bo'lishingiz
mumkin. Uxlash vaqti kelganda,
isinish haqida tashvishlanmang. Muz
mehmonxonasi mehmonlarga uxlash
uchun iliq uxlash xaltalarini beradi.
Mehmonlar issiq ichimlik bilan
uyg'onadi, keyin erta tonggi sauna va
mazali nonushtadan bahramand
bo'lishlari mumkin.

4) Arktika it chanasida yurish, muz
ustida baliq ovlash va chang'i kabi
ochiq havo mashg'ulotlari uchun
mukammal joy. Agar chang'ingiz
bo'lmasa, qabulxona xodimlari sizga
kerak bo'lgan hamma narsani beradi.

5) Muz mehmonxonasiga tashrif -
unutilmas tajriba va qishingizni
jonlantirishning mukammal usuli. Bu
hayotda bir marta keladigan imkonni
qo'ldan boy bermang!


QALIN SO'ZLAR:

  getaway = qisqa sayohat, dam
    olish safari
  igloo = iglu (qor uy)
  tonnes = tonnalar
  thermometer = termometr
  3 degrees below freezing =
    muzlashdan 3 daraja past
  prepared = tayyorlangan
  master chefs = usta oshpazlar
  crystal-clear view = kristaldek
    tiniq manzara
  starry = yulduzli
  sleeping bags = uxlash xaltalari
  outdoor activities = ochiq havo
    mashg'ulotlari
  dog-sledding = it chanasida yurish
  staff = xodimlar
  reception = qabulxona
  unforgettable experience =
    unutilmas tajriba
  liven up = jonlantirmoq


⚠ 'STAFF':

  = xodimlar (jamoaviy ot).
  ⚠ 'the staff ARE' / 'the staff
  WILL' - ko'plik kabi.


⚠ 'AS WELL AS':

  = shuningdek, ...dan tashqari.


⚠ 'TO COMPARE TO/WITH':

  = solishtirmoq.


⚠ 'MIGHT JUST':

  = ehtimol (kutilmaganda).


⚠ 'TO PROVIDE SOMEBODY WITH':

  = kimgadir nimadir bermoq,
  ta'minlamoq.


⚠ 'A CHANCE OF A LIFETIME':

  = hayotda bir marta keladigan
  imkon.


⚠ 'DON'T MISS':

  = qo'ldan boy bermang.

SARLAVHALAR:

  1-xatboshi → C Name/Location/Why
    special (Ice Hotel, Shvetsiya,

exercises.explanationUz:
QAYDLAR:

  NAME/LOCATION/WHY SPECIAL:
    Ice Hotel; northern Sweden;
    giant igloo, 2,000 t ice
  DESCRIPTION:
    rooms for 100+; ice sauna,
    cinema, Ice Chapel, Absolut Ice

exercises.exampleEn: The Ice Hotel is in northern Sweden. It is special because it is a giant igloo made of 2,000 tonnes of ice and 30,000 tonnes of snow.
exercises.exampleUz: Muz mehmonxonasi Shvetsiya shimolida. U alohida, chunki u 2000 tonna muz va 30000 tonna qordan qurilgan ulkan iglu.
modelAnswers: The hotel has rooms for over 100 guests, an ice sauna, a cinema, the Ice Chapel and the famous Absolut Ice Bar. The temperature inside is minus 3 degrees.
Inside, you can have a meal prepared by master chefs, visit the Ice Bar and sleep in a warm sleeping bag. In the morning you can have a sauna and breakfast.
Outside, you can go dog-sledding, ice-fishing and skiing. The staff will give you everything you need.
I think a visit to the Ice Hotel is an unforgettable experience. You shouldn't miss this chance.
modelAnswersUz: Mehmonxonada 100 dan ortiq mehmon uchun xonalar, muz saunasi, kinoteatr, Muz ibodatxonasi va mashhur Absolut Muz bari bor. Ichkaridagi harorat minus 3 daraja.
Ichkarida usta oshpazlar tayyorlagan ovqatni yeyish, Muz bariga borish va iliq uxlash xaltasida uxlash mumkin. Ertalab sauna va nonushta qilish mumkin.
Tashqarida it chanasida yurish, muz ustida baliq ovlash va chang'i uchish mumkin. Xodimlar sizga kerak bo'lgan hamma narsani beradi.
Menimcha, Muz mehmonxonasiga tashrif - unutilmas tajriba. Bu imkonni qo'ldan boy bermasligingiz kerak.

exercises.instructionEn: Study the examples, then say when we use who, where and which.
exercises.instructionUz: Misollarni o'rganing, keyin who, where va which ni qachon ishlatishimizni ayting.
exercises.explanationUz:
NISBIY OLMOShLAR - IKKI GAPNI
BIRLAShTIRISh.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WHO - ODAMLAR                   ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I spoke to a policeman. HE was
  very helpful.
  → I spoke to a policeman WHO was
    very helpful.
  ⚠ 'who' = 'he/she/they' o'rnida.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WHERE - JOYLAR                  ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  I went to Spain. I met my husband
  THERE.
  → I went to Spain WHERE I met my
    husband.
  ⚠ 'where' = 'there' o'rnida.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  WHICH - NARSALAR/HAYVONLAR      ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  A CD player is a machine. IT
  plays music.
  → A CD player is a machine WHICH
    plays music.
  ⚠ 'which' = 'it' o'rnida.


⚠ 'THAT':

  'who' va 'which' o'rnida 'that'
  ham ishlatiladi (so'zlashuvda):
  'a machine THAT plays music'.


⚠ 'HELPFUL':

  = yordamchan, foydali.

points.en: I spoke to a policeman. He was very helpful. → I spoke to a policeman who was very helpful.
points.uz: Men politsiyachi bilan gaplashdim. U juda yordamchan edi. → Men juda yordamchan bo'lgan politsiyachi bilan gaplashdim.

points.en: I went to Spain. I met my husband there. → I went to Spain where I met my husband.
points.uz: Men Ispaniyaga bordim. U yerda erimni uchratdim. → Men erimni uchratgan Ispaniyaga bordim.

points.en: A CD player is a machine. It plays music. → A CD player is a machine which plays music.
points.uz: CD pleyer - bu mashina. U musiqa chaladi. → CD pleyer - musiqa chaladigan mashina.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the jobs to the job descriptions, then make sentences with who, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Kasblarni kasb tavsiflariga moslang, keyin namunadagidek who bilan gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'A barman is someone WHO serves
   drinks.'


MOSLASh:
  1 barman → c serve drinks
  2 porter → e carry luggage
  3 chef → a cook food
  4 maid → f clean rooms
  5 waiter → b serve meals
  6 receptionist → d welcome guests


⚠ 'SOMEONE WHO + FE'L-S':

  'someone' - birlik, fe'lga -S:
  'who serveS', 'who carrieS'.


⚠ MEHMONXONA KASBLARI:

  barman = barmen
  porter = yuk tashuvchi
  chef = oshpaz /ʃef/
  maid = xizmatchi ayol (xona
    tozalovchi)
  waiter = ofitsiant
  receptionist = qabulxona xodimi

⚠ A chef is someone who cooks food.

⚠ A waiter is someone who serves meals.
⚠ A receptionist is someone who welcomes guests.

exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'They went to the Barbican
   Theatre, WHERE they saw Romeo
   and Juliet.'


⚠ Audio kerak, lekin mantiqan
aniq:

  1 Barbican Theatre → b Romeo and
    Juliet (teatr - spektakl)
  2 Trafalgar Square → a Nelson's
    Column (maydondagi ustun)
  3 National Gallery → d paintings
    (galereya - rasmlar)
  4 Savoy Hotel → e afternoon tea
    (mashhur mehmonxona choyi)
  5 Highbury Stadium → c football
    match (stadion)


⚠ LONDON JOYLARI:

  Barbican Theatre - teatr
  Trafalgar Square - markaziy
    maydon, Nelson ustuni bilan
  National Gallery - Milliy rasm
    galereyasi
  Savoy Hotel - mashhur hashamatli
    mehmonxona
  Highbury Stadium - Arsenal
    futbol klubining eski stadioni


⚠ 'AFTERNOON TEA':

  = tushdan keyingi choy (ingliz
  an'anasi - choy, sendvich, pirog).


⚠ 'TO ADMIRE':

  = zavqlanib tomosha qilmoq,
  hayratlanmoq.


⚠ 'A COLUMN':

  = ustun. /ˈkɒləm/ - 'n' o'qilmaydi.

⚠ They went to Trafalgar Square, where they saw Nelson's Column.
⚠ They went to the National Gallery, where they admired the paintings.
⚠ They went to the Savoy Hotel, where they had afternoon tea.
⚠ They went to Highbury Stadium, where they watched a football match.

exercises.explanationUz:
⚠ 'They went to [joy], WHERE they
[fe'l - PAST SIMPLE] ...'

  see → saw; admire → admired;
  have → had; watch → watched.
